findings.title: On a phone, WhatsApp is only an unlabelled icon in a bottom bar; nothing in the page itself offers it
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The first phone screen shows the greeting, four badges and Hadas's photo; the only labelled action is 'פה יוצרים קשר' in the top corner, which opens a contact form, and WhatsApp is a small unlabelled black icon in a bar at the bottom shared with an email icon.
findings.fix_in_new_site: contact.whatsapp = +972546686808 drives the one labelled primary action on the first screen and in the persistent mobile bar (playbook §3); the header contact button becomes that same WhatsApp link
findings.notes: tools/funnel.mjs 0.2.0 browses with Chromium's own user agent, so Wix serves it the 980 px desktop page, which has no WhatsApp or tel link; a phone (iPhone UA, funnel/walk.mjs) gets Wix's mobile layout with a fixed WhatsApp + email bar on every page. The tool's numbers are copied unchanged in `measured`; the hand walk corrects them only where stated. Hand walk: the bar is position:fixed at the bottom of every page (walk-raw.json, 'WhatsApp' → https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=972546686808); funnel.json landing_actions list only the footer email and the newsletter form, both below the fold.

findings.title: A desktop visitor has no WhatsApp and no tappable phone link anywhere
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On a computer the home page offers 'פה יוצרים קשר' (a form) and Spotify in the header; the WhatsApp the business answers first does not exist, and the phone number in the footer is plain text.
findings.fix_in_new_site: contact.whatsapp builds the same wa.me link at every width (it is a real link and works on WhatsApp Web, playbook §5); contact.phone as tel: beside it
findings.notes: funnel/walk/clicks.json: desktop 1440 page, whatsapp_links 0, tel_links 0 in the rendered HTML.

findings.title: The two leading service pages end in a Calendly button several screens down and never offer WhatsApp
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: A visitor reading 'פיתוח עסק עם משמעות' (personal branding) reaches its only action, 'לקביעת פגישה' (Calendly), after about six phone screens; on 'תהליך המיתוג' (strategic planning) 'לקביעת פגישת הכרות' is about four screens down; neither page has a WhatsApp or phone action in its body.
findings.fix_in_new_site: each services[] row with group lead gets its own CTA built from services[].ctaText (prefilled wa.me message naming the service); bookingUrl = the Calendly intro call shown beside it, never instead of it
findings.notes: funnel.json: clicks_to_book 2, primary engine 'לקביעת פגישת הכרות' on /process (top 1937 of the desktop page). Hand walk (phone layout, 692 px screens): /personal101 CTA at 4421 of 6532 px, /process at 2791 of 3542 px (walk-raw.json).

findings.title: 'Update me about the next course' leads to the payment page of a past 2025 workshop
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On the course page 'מעסק למותג מיטיב' the visitor reads 'ההרשמה נסגרה'; its button 'עדכני אותי על הקורס הבא' opens 'MAP YOUR VISION 2025 … תודה שנרשמת! אפשרויות התשלום' with Bit, PayBox and card payment — a different, finished workshop.
findings.fix_in_new_site: services[] row for the course with status 'full' or 'ended' (ended is hidden, not left stale) and its ctaText asking on WhatsApp about the next run; /register and the duplicate pages become redirects (posts/services old URLs rule)

findings.title: Brand & Breakfast still takes sign-ups for Friday 15.5.26, a date that has passed
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The page invites the visitor to 'יום שישי 15.5.26' and ends in a sign-up form ('אני רוצה להבין יותר'); nothing says the date is over or when the next one is.
findings.fix_in_new_site: services[].dates[] (past dates are not rendered) and services[].status; with no future date the card shows the offer and its WhatsApp ctaText instead of a dated sign-up

findings.title: Workshop 'הרשמה' buttons open a generic registration lightbox, not a dated booking
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Tapping 'הרשמה' or 'ספרי לי עוד' on the lectures and workshops page opens a 'הרשמה' pop-up form (workshop dropdown, name, email, phone, reCAPTCHA); none of the offers carries a date, so the visitor registers interest and waits.
findings.fix_in_new_site: each secondary services[] row (group talks_workshops / courses) ends in its own WhatsApp action from services[].ctaText; bookingUrl only where an external registration page exists
findings.notes: Correction to the dossier with evidence: dossier.json#offers_note says the 'הרשמה' buttons have no link target. They have no href, but on the phone layout they open a Wix lightbox form (clicks.json: dialogs 1, no navigation). The form was opened, never filled or sent.

findings.title: The same offer shows two different prices on two pages
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: A visitor comparing pages sees the professional Brand the Change course at 5200 ש"ח + מע"מ on the workshops page and 2,850 ₪ on its Wix booking page, and THE BETTER 4 at 480 ש"ח + מע"מ versus 350 ש״ח on /smst.
findings.playbook_ref: §2 what does it cost; site-content 'Offers are one list'
findings.fix_in_new_site: one services[] row per offer with price / currency ILS / unit / vat — a price lives in one place; the duplicate pages redirect
findings.notes: Which price is current is a dossier gap (dossier.json#gaps offers.btc-professionals.price, offers.the-better-4.price) for the owner to confirm; the audit does not choose.

findings.title: The menu names neither leading service
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: A visitor looking for personal branding or strategic planning finds menu items 'פיתוח עסק עם משמעות' and 'תהליך המיתוג'; the words 'מיתוג אישי' and 'תכנון אסטרטגי' appear only on the home cards. The phone menu has no contact item.
findings.fix_in_new_site: the menu lists services[] rows of group lead by services[].title, each at /<slug>; the persistent WhatsApp bar replaces the missing contact item

findings.title: The blog and its category pages returned server errors during the crawl
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Tapping 'בלוג' in the menu showed a white 'ERROR: INTERNAL SERVER ERROR 500 … try again in a few minutes' page; 9 of the 30 crawled pages answered 503 (the blog, 6 category pages, a tag page, a post). The same blog loaded on a later visit.
findings.fix_in_new_site: posts collection rendered at /blog/<slug> as static pages (playbook §11); posts[].oldUrl redirects keep the old addresses
findings.notes: Intermittent: funnel.json pages_with_errors (2026-10-18T09:38Z); the walk at ~09:45Z got /blog 200. The harvester saw the same random 500s (dossier existing_site.notes).

findings.title: The phone home page loads about 5.9 MB and paints its largest element after about 3.3 s on an unthrottled connection
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On a phone the home page downloads ~5.9 MB before it settles — four times the playbook's first-load budget — and that was measured without throttling.
findings.fix_in_new_site: static build within playbook §4's budget (≤ 1.5 MB first load, LCP ≤ 2.5 s); the Vee overlay and analytics iframes are not carried over (§4 no third parties)
findings.notes: Numbers are the harvester's single headless run (make-old-site.sh), not re-measured by the auditor.

findings.title: A third-party accessibility widget and its button sit over every page
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: A round accessibility button floats over the content on every page and its panel of 21 controls (Vee) loads with it.
findings.fix_in_new_site: accessibility built into the template (WCAG 2.1 AA, playbook §10) and the statement kept as legal.accessibilityStatement + legal.accessibilityContact at /accessibility

findings.title: A graphic on the desktop course page links to a Wix 404 page
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On a computer, the yellow chevron on 'מעסק למותג מיטיב' opens /blank-2, titled '404 Error Page'.
findings.fix_in_new_site: not carried over: the template's links come from services[] / posts slugs only

findings.title: The award badge does not say what it is, and the award text sits in a collaborator's bio
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The home hero shows an 'ISRAEL BRAND AWARD 2022' seal with '1st PLACE Branding for non profit organizations' (desktop) and no link; further down the 2022 nonprofit-branding award appears in Dana Russo's team bio, not as the practice's own.
findings.fix_in_new_site: awards[] row (label, issuer Brand Academy, year 2022, project ברטלי, url = brandawards.co.il winners page) next to the services; caseStudies[].award links it to a project

findings.title: The contact email is on another business's domain and the footer says 2019
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The footer of every page gives Hadas@kapara.com and '@2019 This blog was created to be shared'.
findings.fix_in_new_site: contact.email (the owner may change it to a brand-domain address — owner decision, a pitch point only); the footer year is the template's

findings.title: The home page has no main heading
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Screen readers and search engines find no <h1> on the phone home page; the desktop page marks footer labels as <h1>.
findings.fix_in_new_site: the template sets one <h1> from businessName/tagline per page (playbook §10)
findings.notes: walk-raw.json: home h1 = [] (phone layout); raw desktop HTML has 3 <h1> elements.

findings.title: From Instagram, the visitor passes through a Linktree that offers no WhatsApp
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Instagram's bio link opens a Linktree with the site, Instagram and LinkedIn; to message Hadas the visitor must open the site and find the bottom-bar icon.
findings.fix_in_new_site: the site's first screen carries the labelled WhatsApp action, so the one Linktree tap lands next to it
findings.notes: Linktree rendered 2026-10-18 (phone UA): links https://www.mutagmeitiv.com/ (twice), instagram.com/mutagmeitiv, linkedin.com/in/hadasdrachli. The dossier also lists Spotify there; not seen in this render.

recommended.offer_framing: services[] in three groups: the two lead rows (personal branding, strategic planning) each with title, summary, format, audience, the 4 method.stages[] and its own WhatsApp ctaText, Calendly intro call as bookingUrl; then talks_workshops and courses rows with price/currency ILS/unit/vat only where published, status and dates[] so past runs are hidden; proof (testimonials[] in their own language, awards[], credentials[], clientLogos[]) beside the lead services
recommended.closing_intent: invite the purpose-driven owner to a first conversation on WhatsApp and name the free Zoom intro call as the alternative

off_site.advice: add a WhatsApp link to the Linktree, or point the Instagram bio straight at the new site

not_measurable: reply time on WhatsApp, Calendly or the forms — no contact with the owner from the audit (constraint 10)
whether the contact, Brand & Breakfast and lightbox registration forms deliver — forms are never submitted
Calendly's own pages beyond the hand-off (both links answer HTTP 200; dates not opened)
Google Business Profile — none found by the harvester, Maps not queryable from here (dossier.json#reviews.google)
Instagram bio link and DM path — logged-out view only; the bio-link target is taken from the dossier
conversion, traffic or sources — no analytics access
tools/funnel.mjs on the phone layout — the tool has no user-agent option, so its numbers describe Wix's desktop page at 390 px; the phone layout was measured by hand (funnel/walk.mjs)
